svg.aria-label: Hit@1 and answer accuracy over 60 questions, one run: BM25 70% and 85%, dense 72% and 88%, hybrid 75% and 92%, hybrid plus parents 75% and 87%, vectorless with headings only 82% and 92%, vectorless with summaries 95% and 98%. Only the Hit@1 gain of vectorless with summaries over hybrid is significant, p = 0.002; the answer-accuracy gain is not, p = 0.22.
